They’re not giving the green light.

The city shot down a Queens elementary school’s request for a stoplight for a third time — crushing a campaign led by the students who watched a car smash into their crossing guard last year.

Drivers treat the streets outside PS 29Q in College Point like a racetrack at all hours of the day, putting students’ lives at risk every day, fumed City Councilmember Vickie Paladino (R-Queens).

“There were cars constantly going by with no regard to the fact that it’s by a school, no regard for anything,” Paladino told The Post.

The politician railed against the latest rejection on social media last week, saying the city failed to “give this school what it needs” — especially in the wake of the crash.

The crossing guard was escorting children through the 125th Street and 23rd Avenue intersection at 8 a.m. in March 2025 when a car smashed into her, according to a police report.

The 47-year-old was rushed to the hospital with neck, forehead and knee injuries — and continues to suffer from the trauma today, police and the councilwoman said.

The elementary school had asked numerous times for a stoplight, a four-way stop sign or speed bumps in the wake of the crash, but the city Department of Transportation ruled that the intersection didn’t need extra safety measures.

Instead, officials installed a four-way stop sign one block east of the intersection, which Paladino said “did nothing” to curb the incessant speeding.

Students led their own “Call to Action” and sent a series of letters to the DOT pleading for some form of speed reduction infrastructure at the dangerous cross street.

“We have a problem in our community,” one student wrote in a letter, saying they “noticed cars have been speeding a lot lately.

“To me, this puts many lives in danger … If we don’t take action now, then it is possible for another accident like the one last year to happen again … Please we need your help!”

The campaign involved letters, phone calls, 311 reports and more, according to Paladino.

“And yet: denied, denied, deny. Multi-way stop sign: denied. Speed hump: denied. Traffic signal: denied,” the Queens politician told The Post.

“Jesus, Mary and Joseph, what the hell?”

A DOT spokesperson told The Post that it had reviewed traffic and pedestrian volumes surrounding the school, and identified two other intersections as ideal spots for speed reduction measures.

An all-way stop sign was installed at 25th Avenue and 126th Street last year, just one block north of another that was installed on the same street in 2021.

“Every New Yorker deserves safe streets and school children ought to be protected as they travel to and from school,” the spokesperson said.

“NYC DOT has recently installed two all-way stop signs around this school in response to community requests— these decisions are guided by safety data and unique local conditions, and we will always work with communities to make our streets safer for everyone.”
news.content: پوشش های بیشتری را در نتایج جستجوی خود مشاهده کنید. آنها چراغ سبز نشان نمی دهند. شهر برای سومین بار درخواست مدرسه ابتدایی کوئینز برای چراغ توقف را رد کرد - کمپینی را که دانش آموزانی که سال گذشته شاهد برخورد اتومبیل با نگهبان گذرگاهشان بودند، سرکوب کرد. ویکی پالادینو (R-Queens) یکی از اعضای شورای شهر را خشمگین کرد، رانندگان در تمام ساعات روز با خیابان‌های خارج از PS 29Q در کالج پوینت مانند یک پیست مسابقه‌ای برخورد می‌کنند و هر روز جان دانش‌آموزان را به خطر می‌اندازند. پالادینو به The Post گفت: «ماشین‌هایی دائماً بدون توجه به این واقعیت که در کنار یک مدرسه است و بدون توجه به چیزی از آن‌جا عبور می‌کردند. این سیاستمدار هفته گذشته با انتقاد از آخرین رد در رسانه های اجتماعی، گفت که شهر نتوانست "آنچه را که به این مدرسه نیاز دارد" بدهد - به ویژه در پی تصادف. نگهبان گذرگاه در ساعت 8 صبح در مارس 2025 در حال اسکورت کودکان از خیابان 125 و تقاطع خیابان 23 بود که طبق گزارش پلیس، یک خودرو با او برخورد کرد. این مرد 47 ساله با آسیب های گردن، پیشانی و زانو سریعاً به بیمارستان منتقل شد - و همچنان از تروما رنج می برد، پلیس و خانم شورا گفتند. مدرسه ابتدایی بارها درخواست چراغ توقف، علامت توقف چهار طرفه یا سرعت گیر در پی تصادف کرده بود، اما اداره حمل و نقل شهر تصمیم گرفت اقدامات ایمنی اضافی را در تقاطع انجام دهد. در عوض، مقامات یک تابلوی توقف چهارطرفه در یک بلوک شرق تقاطع نصب کردند که پالادینو گفت: «هیچ کاری نکرد» تا جلوی آن را بگیرد.

Things got intense between veteran guards Jaylen Brown and Grayson Allen as a battle for a loose ball got scrappy during a Halloween clash.

Midway through the fourth quarter, the 76ers star drove to the basket but was swarmed by Hornets near the baseline.

He and Allen both ended up on the hardwood grabbing for the ball.

JAYLEN BROWN AND GRAYSON ALLEN 🍿  pic.twitter.com/HDUinsD5l7

A scuffle then followed as the ball went out of bounds. Allen pushed away Brown’s arm as the Hornets offseason addition tried to get up. Brown took exception to the push and shoved Allen back down.

Players from each team got in between Brown and Allen before the incident escalated further. Both players were assessed technical fouls by the referees.

Grayson Allen is no stranger to conflict.

The 31-year-old sharpshooter from Duke has built a reputation for getting under opposing players’ skin since his college days.

Allen always brings a competitive fire to each game that can appear to be excessive in certain moments, and has been behind a ton of instances where a ball handler was undercut while attempting a basket.

The nine-year pro previously got into a hectic situation with now-Thunder player Alex Caruso back in 2022 with the Chicago Bulls when Allen was playing for the Milwaukee Bucks.

Allen got ejected after being assessed a Flagrant 2 foul for dragging down a mid-air Caruso while defending a Bulls fast break.

When Caruso was up in the air, Allen flew in and swatted at Caruso, sending the Bulls guard into a hard collision with the hardwood floor.

The Hornets led for most of Saturday’s game, but Brown and the 76ers rallied late to earn a 109-104 comeback win. Brown finished with a decent stat line of 16 points, four rebounds, and four assists. Allen led the Hornets with 27 points, including seven 3-pointers off the bench.
news.content: پوشش ما را در نتایج جستجوی خود مشاهده کنید. همه چیز بین گاردهای کهنه کار جیلن براون و گریسون آلن شدید شد زیرا نبرد برای یک توپ شل در طول یک درگیری هالووین خراب شد. در اواسط کوارتر چهارم، ستاره 76ers به سمت سبد رفت اما توسط هورنتز در نزدیکی خط اصلی ازدحام کرد. براون و گریسون آلن 🍿 pic.twitter.com/HDUinsD5l7 درگیری و درگیری به وجود آمد که توپ از محدوده خارج شد. در حالی که بازیکن خارج از فصل هورنتز سعی در بلند شدن داشت، آلن بازوی براون را کنار زد. براون از هل دادن مستثنی شد و آلن را به عقب هل داد. بازیکنان هر تیم قبل از تشدید حادثه بین براون و آلن قرار گرفتند. هر دو بازیکن خطاهای فنی توسط داوران ارزیابی شدند. گریسون آلن با درگیری غریبه نیست. این تیرانداز 31 ساله از دوک از دوران دانشگاهش به خاطر زیر پوست بازیکنان حریف شهرت پیدا کرده است. آلن همیشه در هر بازی آتش رقابتی به ارمغان می آورد که ممکن است در لحظات خاصی بیش از حد به نظر برسد، و پشت بسیاری از مواردی بوده است که در آن یک نگهدارنده توپ هنگام تلاش برای زدن سبد، ضربه خورده است. این حرفه ای 9 ساله قبلاً در سال 2022 در شیکاگو بولز، زمانی که آلن برای میلواکی باکس بازی می کرد، با الکس کاروسو، بازیکن کنونی تاندر، در موقعیتی هولناک قرار گرفت. آلن پس از ارزیابی خطای Flagrant 2 به دلیل کشیدن کاروسو در هوا در حین دفاع از بولز سریع در حال دفاع از کاروسو، اخراج شد.

news.originalContent:

Haley Stevens is a “proud Democrat” who bashed GOP candidate Mike Rogers just this past summer.

So think about how bad Democratic nominee Abdul El-Sayed must be for Stevens to cross the political aisle and endorse Rogers, the Republican candidate she initially dismissed, for senator from Michigan.

So bad that El-Sayed dismissed an attack on a synagogue full of children by blaming Israel, claiming that “hurt people hurt people.”

So bad that when El-Sayed was asked whether Iran or Israel was the greater threat to the US, he answered both.

So bad that El-Sayed refused to denounce an advertisement that blamed Israel for high inflation.

Stevens had begged for El-Sayed to stop blaming the Jewish state for everything wrong in this world, and El-Sayed refused.

So Stevens did the only sensible thing: She is backing Rogers on the eve of Tuesday’s election, warning Michigan and the nation of the dangers posed by Abdul El-Sayed.

The progressives are already screaming, declaring her a “traitor.” But this is not a betrayal. It is a singular act of courage.

Stevens has nothing to gain here. The Democratic machine, which prioritizes winning over morals, will disown her. She’s not looking for a future as a Republican. There is no money, no glory in this. There is only principle.

Haley Stevens hasn’t changed, the party has changed, beholden now to the deranged “Free Palestine” antisemitic mob that cheers the terror of Hamas. She’s tried cautioning the Democrats. She’s tried convincing them. In the end, she came to the realization that so many Jewish-Americans have, to their sadness: The party has abandoned them.

Hopefully her bravery will make a difference with voters this Election Day. Heed her warning.
news.content:
پوشش ما را در نتایج جستجوی خود مشاهده کنید. هیلی استیونز یک "دموکرات مغرور" است که در تابستان گذشته مایک راجرز نامزد حزب جمهوری خواه را مورد ضرب و شتم قرار داد. پس به این فکر کنید که نامزد دموکرات ها برای استیونز چقدر بد است تا بتواند از راهروی سیاسی عبور کند و از راجرز، نامزد جمهوری خواه که در ابتدا از میگانسن برکنار شد، فکر کنید. آنقدر بد که السید با سرزنش اسرائیل حمله به کنیسه ای پر از کودکان را رد کرد و مدعی شد که "آزار دادن به مردم به مردم صدمه می زند."
آنقدر بد که وقتی از السید پرسیدند که آیا ایران یا اسرائیل تهدید بزرگ‌تری برای ایالات متحده است، او به هر دو پاسخ داد. آنقدر بد که السید از محکوم کردن تبلیغاتی که اسرائیل را به دلیل تورم بالا مقصر می‌دانست، خودداری کرد. استیونز از السید التماس کرده بود که دولت یهود را به خاطر هر اشتباهی که در این دنیا وجود دارد سرزنش نکند، و السید نپذیرفت. بنابراین استیونز تنها کار معقول را انجام داد: او در آستانه انتخابات روز سه شنبه از راجرز حمایت می کند و به میشیگان و ملت درباره خطرات ناشی از عبدالالسید هشدار می دهد. اما این خیانت نیست. این یک اقدام منحصر به فرد از شجاعت است. استیونز در اینجا چیزی برای به دست آوردن ندارد. ماشین دموکرات که پیروزی بر اخلاق را اولویت دارد، او را رد خواهد کرد. او به عنوان یک جمهوری خواه به دنبال آینده ای نیست. در این نه پولی وجود دارد و نه شکوهی. تنها یک اصل وجود دارد. هیلی استیونز تغییر نکرده است، حزب تغییر کرده است، اکنون مواظب اوباش یهودی ستیز «فلسطین آزاد» است که وحشت حماس را تشویق می کند. او تلاش می کند

Ben Bolch’s Big Ten Power Rankings

Game of the week: No. 5 UCLA (8-0 overall, 5-0 Big Ten) at Minnesota (5-3, 3-2), 9 a.m. PST Saturday on FOX. This is perhaps the biggest remaining hurdle the Bruins must clear on their way to the College Football Playoff. The Golden Gophers are incredibly hard to beat at home, where they’ve toppled Michigan and Iowa in low-scoring slugfests.

1. UCLA (8-0) Hasn’t faced a challenge it couldn’t meet under Bob Chesney. (Last week: 2)

3. Ohio State (6-2) After that performance we’re tempted to drop Buckeyes below Rutgers. (1)

3. Indiana (8-1) Hoosiers have two weeks to figure out their shaky quarterback situation. (3)

4. Iowa (6-2) Hawkeyes wishing USC was on their schedule after dismantling Wisconsin. (7)

5. Wisconsin (5-3) Fans are going to badger Luke Fickell again after that pathetic showing. (4)

6. Minnesota (5-3) Good? Average? This is the most difficult team to figure out in the Big Ten. (6)

7. Oregon (5-3) Ducks quack under pressure, pulling out a big win over ranked Wildcats. (8)

12. Washington (5-3) It’s Demond Williams Jr. to the rescue as QB confusion continues. (13)

13. Nebraska (5-3) Safe to say that Matt Rhule will never remind anyone of Tom Osborne. (9)

14. Penn State (4-4) Yay! The once-mighty Nittany Lions won’t go winless in the Big Ten. (15)

15. Purdue (3-5) Boilermakers suffering from regression to mediocrity. (14)

16. Michigan State (2-5) Wants Protect College Sports Act to include more bye weeks. (16)

17. Rutgers (2-6) Just a bad, bad team in the land of goodfellas. (17)

18. Maryland (2-6) 2027 can’t get here soon enough. (18)

Two Florida parents were arrested after their child was discovered wading alone in a pond — leading cops to discover an alleged house of horrors full of animal feces and roaches.

Deputies rushed to a retention pond on Deltona after receiving a call about an unaccompanied toddler on Saturday morning, according to the Volusia Sheriff’s Office.

There, officers located the 4-year-old boy splashing around the pond in a marshy area, before they picked him up and put him into a patrol car, bodycam footage showed.

“Hey, come here … It’s OK,” a deputy could be heard telling the youngster as he plucks him out of the body of water.

After the child identified his home, cops uncovered “filthy conditions,” including “copious animal waste, a roach infestation, and mold,” the department said in a statement.

Inside, authorities also disturbingly found a caged and neglected dog, which was turned over to Deltona Animal Control.

Parents Fermin Medrano-Perez, 26, and Jeneixa Rodriguez-Crespo, 24, were cuffed and charged with child neglect and animal cruelty.

A grandparent took custody of the boy, and the Florida Department of Children and Families was contacted for a follow-up.

After striking a reunion with DeForest Buckner earlier this week, the San Francisco 49ers were on the verge of bringing back another former player.

During “The Inside Scoop” segment of the “Fox NFL Sunday” pregame show with Jay Glazer, he revealed the 49ers had a deal in place for Jauan Jennings this week, but he ended up denying the homecoming.

“The 49ers who traded for DeForest Buckner also had a trade terms worked out for Jauan Jennings — their former receiver,” Glazer said. “It was contingent on him hopping on a FaceTime with Kyle Shanahan and John Lynch and saying ‘Okay, yeah I wanna come back.’ But he didn’t.”

“He said, ‘Actually, I wanna stay here in Minnesota,'” Glazer added.

More on the Jeffery Simmons trade to the Bears and other updates ahead of the trade deadline from @jayglazer pic.twitter.com/gb3hL5uj08

Jennings’ choice to stay with the Vikings isn’t necessarily a bad decision on his part, as they entered Sunday 6-0 — the last undefeated team in the NFL.

Jennings, who’s known for delivering explosive plays, has been utilized in the slot, playing alongside Justin Jefferson and Jordan Addison, where he has been limited in his contribution with only four receptions for 43 yards and zero touchdowns this season.

Buckner was just been one of the many reunions San Francisco has had over the past year, as they also brought back Dre Greenlaw and Deebo Samuel during the offseason.

After leading the team in receiving touchdowns (9) last season, Jennings left the 49ers and signed a one-year deal with the Vikings over the offseason.

Jennings spent the first five years of his career in San Francisco and helped the 49ers make one Super Bowl appearance (2024) and make the playoffs four times.

San Francisco selected him in the seventh round of the 2021 NFL Draft, and he had his breakout season in 2024, when he had 77 receptions for 975 yards and six touchdowns.

The potential addition of Jennings would’ve helped bring a boost to an injured 49ers wide receiver room that features Samuel, Mike Evans, Ricky Pearsall, and Christian Kirk.

A 27-year-old woman was followed into a Bedford-Stuyvesant apartment building and sexually assaulted early Sunday, police said.

The attack happened at 12:30 a.m. near Bedford Avenue and Willoughby Avenue in Brooklyn, according to the NYPD.

The suspect first slapped the woman’s rear end on the street before following her into the building and sexually assaulting her there, too, police said.

It is not clear if the woman knew the man.

The victim was treated at a local hospital.

news.originalContent:

Sen. Bernie Sanders has lashed out at deep-pocketed donors protecting their fortunes for a drop in support for the California billionaire tax.

Sanders, responding to a poll showing more voters are against the measure than in favor, claimed that West Coast billionaires had become $500 billion richer in the last year and criticized what he described as efforts to protect their fortunes while children lack healthcare.

“They are doing phenomenally well and really [it] is quite disgusting, to my mind, that they think it’s more important that they hang on to their $200 billion rather than make sure the kids of California have health care,” he told KCRA’s Ashley Zavala in an interview Sunday.

The biggest news, opinion and culture shaping California right now.

Please provide a valid email.

By clicking above you agree to the Terms of Use and Privacy Policy.

Proposition 40, described as a one-time 5% wealth tax on billionaires that would primarily fund healthcare, was opposed by 52.6% of voters, while 34.5% supported it and 11.5% were undecided, according to a California Post poll conducted by McLaughlin & Associates.

Sanders framed the results as part of a broader fight over wealth and access to care. “The fact of the matter is, we have more income and wealth inequality in America today,” he said.

Pollster John McLaughlin offered a different explanation for the measure’s weakness, saying voters distrust state lawmakers on taxes.

“Voters just don’t trust Sacramento politicians when it comes to taxes. Whenever pollsters ask should we raise taxes on billionaires? People say why not but naturally when we ask should they raise taxes on you? People say no — especially when affordability is the top issue,” said pollster John McLaughlin.

Google co-founder Sergey Brin, the world’s fourth-richest person, is among those who are spending money to block Proposition 40. He has spent more than $100 million opposing California’s proposed billionaire tax, which could cost him an estimated $13.3 billion.

Brin, whose fortune is estimated at about $267 billion, recently donated an additional $20 million to Build a Better California, an organization campaigning against the tax, according to a recent filing.

Former Google CEO Eric Schmidt and cryptocurrency mogul Chris Larsen have joined him with eight-figure contributions.

news.content: پوشش های بیشتری را در نتایج جستجوی خود مشاهده کنید.Sen. برنی سندرز از اهداکنندگان پولی که از دارایی‌های خود محافظت می‌کنند به دلیل کاهش حمایت از مالیات میلیاردرهای کالیفرنیا انتقاد کرده است. سندرز، در پاسخ به یک نظرسنجی که نشان می‌دهد رای دهندگان بیشتری با این اقدام مخالف هستند تا موافق، مدعی شد که میلیاردرهای ساحل غربی در سال گذشته 500 میلیارد دلار ثروتمندتر شده‌اند و از آنچه او به عنوان تلاش برای محافظت از دارایی‌شان توصیف کرد در حالی که کودکان فاقد مراقبت‌های بهداشتی هستند، انتقاد کرد. او یکشنبه در مصاحبه ای با اشلی زاوالا از KCRA گفت: "آنها به طرز خارق العاده ای خوب کار می کنند و واقعا [این] بسیار منزجر کننده است، به نظر من، این که فکر می کنند مهم تر است که به 200 میلیارد دلار خود پایبند باشند تا اطمینان حاصل کنند که بچه های کالیفرنیا مراقبت های بهداشتی دارند." سیاست. بر اساس نظرسنجی کالیفرنیا پست که توسط مک لافلین و همکاران انجام شد، پیشنهاد 40، که به عنوان مالیات بر ثروت یکباره 5 درصدی برای میلیاردرها توصیف می شود که در درجه اول تأمین مالی مراقبت های بهداشتی است، با مخالفت 52.6 درصد از رأی دهندگان روبرو شد، در حالی که 34.5 درصد از آن حمایت کردند و 11.5 درصد نیز بلاتکلیف بودند. او گفت: «واقعیت این است که ما امروز در آمریکا نابرابری درآمد و ثروت بیشتری داریم. جان مک لافلین، نظرسنجی، توضیح متفاوتی برای ضعف این اقدام ارائه کرد و گفت رأی دهندگان به قانونگذاران ایالتی در مورد مالیات بی اعتماد هستند.

news.originalContent:
(Photo by Ivan Romano/Getty Images)

Europe’s political establishment is facing a growing nationalist backlash over years of permissive immigration policies, with young Europeans taking to the streets to demand tougher borders and an end to mass migration.

From Italy to Spain and France, demonstrations have attracted thousands of participants, ranging from conventional conservatives demanding immigration reform to openly fascist organizations embracing the symbols of Europe’s authoritarian past. While some marchers carry torches and perform Roman salutes, others are ordinary nationalists concerned about their countries’ borders, highlighting the distinction between conservative movements and extremist groups seeking to capitalize on public frustration.

And their concerns about the scale of immigration are backed by official statistics, with asylum applications in the European Union surging from approximately 260,000 in 2010 to more than 1.3 million in 2015, according to the European Council. The influx, driven partly by wars in Syria, Iraq and Afghanistan, coincided with approximately 1.8 million detected irregular border crossings in 2015 alone, according to the European Council.

The migration pressures persisted into the following decade, with first-time asylum applications climbing to approximately 1.05 million in 2023 after declining during the COVID-19 pandemic, according to Eurostat. Although applications declined to approximately 669,400 in 2025, millions of Ukrainians displaced by Russia’s invasion were also living under temporary protection across the bloc, according to the European Council.

The fascist label has also been directed at electoral conservatives, with British Reform UK council leader George Finch alleging he was called a “fascist” before an assault, according to The Guardian.

In Germany, a Guardian opinion column linked opposition to the AfD with combating fascism, although a German court subsequently blocked authorities from designating the entire party as confirmed extremist pending a final ruling, Reuters reported.

(Photo by Ivan Romano/Getty Images)

The nationalist demonstrations take on new significance as widespread unrest grips France and Italy, where rioters looted Milan storefronts, torched vehicles and set the historic city hall in Limoges ablaze during October protests, according to the Associated Press. Some of the “protestors” allegedly crossed the line into terrorism when they decided to openly carry firearms.

In Milan, approximately 2,000 demonstrators marched through the streets on April 29, carrying Italian flags and torches before performing Roman salutes in unison, according to Reuters and ANSA. (RELATED: Europe’s Riots Take Terrifying Turn As Anti-Terror Police Investigate Arson, Reports Of Armed Rioters Surface)

One video uploaded by a far-right account on X shows the Roman Salutes at the finale of the march. The video was corroborated and can be seen from a different angle in an article uploaded by Italian news agency La Stampa.

The nighttime procession commemorated Sergio Ramelli, an 18-year-old activist affiliated with the Italian Social Movement’s youth organization who died in 1975 after being attacked by far-left militants. Participants marched in organized columns toward a memorial on Via Paladini, where they conducted a ceremony honoring fallen comrades, according to ANSA.

Among the demonstrators were activists associated with neo-fascist CasaPound Italia and Lealtà Azione, organizations operating within Italy’s nationalist movement. Participants carried a banner honoring fallen comrades, while the procession’s conclusion featured the synchronized fascist-era salute, ANSA reported.

One image posted by ANSA further corroborates the previous video, showing a different angle of the procession finale, complete with Italian flags and Roman salutes.

Camice nere e saluti romani, la sfilata fascista per Ramelli a Milano https://t.co/bJF1vaD1dD

The demonstration was particularly notable for its scale and its participants’ open use of symbols associated with Benito Mussolini’s fascist dictatorship. Milan Mayor Giuseppe Sala condemned the Roman salutes while acknowledging Ramelli’s place among the victims of Italy’s historical political violence, according to ANSA.

The Milan gathering was not organized as an immigration protest, however, and its size does not establish that Italy’s neo-fascist organizations are attracting more members than in previous years. Rather, it demonstrates that groups explicitly embracing elements of the country’s fascist history retain the organizational capacity to stage substantial public demonstrations.

The connection to contemporary immigration politics became much clearer in Rome on June 13, when thousands of demonstrators marched through the Italian capital demanding the remigration of illegal African and Muslim immigrants back to their countries of origin, according to the Associated Press and La Repubblica.

The demonstration included activists from nationalist organizations such as CasaPound and Veneto Fronte Skinheads, with approximately 4,000 participants reported by La Repubblica. Some shouted slogans praising Mussolini and performed Roman salutes during the march, according to the Associated Press and ANSA.

One video uploaded by Italian news agency Repubblica shows what the event looked like.

Al corteo “Remigrazione e riconquista”, organizzato a Roma dal comitato guidato da Luca Marsella e sostenuto anche da realtà dell’estrema destra come CasaPound, si sono viste decine di tricolori, cori come «non siamo antifascisti» e braccia tese, anche durante l’Inno d’Italia. La manifestazione è stata promossa a sostegno della proposta di legge di iniziativa popolare sulla “remigrazione”. Marsella ha illustrato il programma del movimento, sostenendo la necessità di espellere gli immigrati irregolari e favorire il rimpatrio degli stranieri, «ma non come l’Ice». Video Romina Marceca / Agtw

The march also attracted participants from abroad, including representatives of nationalist networks in Poland, Hungary and Spain. Demonstrators carried Italian flags through Rome’s Prati district while police maintained a significant security presence, according to La Repubblica.

Italy’s electoral conservatives and openly fascist street organizations should not be treated as interchangeable. Opposition to illegal immigration, demands for stronger borders and support for deporting people without legal status do not, by themselves, constitute fascism, whereas the groups participating in these demonstrations have openly displayed fascist-era symbolism.

Spain has witnessed similarly explicit displays, including one demonstration in which teenagers reportedly constituted much of the crowd.

On May 23, 2025, approximately 300 demonstrators affiliated with Falange Española marched through Madrid demanding the removal of immigrants, with the average participant reportedly around 18 years old, according to Research Against Global Authoritarianism and El País.

Many participants wore black clothing, carried Spanish flags and marched in organized rows while promoting remigration. Some delivered fascist salutes and sang the Falangist anthem, according to El País.

The Falange traces its political identity to the movement founded by José Antonio Primo de Rivera, whose ideology became closely associated with Francisco Franco’s dictatorship. The organization’s continued use of historical fascist symbols makes the Madrid procession materially different from conventional conservative demonstrations over immigration policy.

One incident went viral during the protests in Spain, where Spanish women brought shower gel to the event, pointing out how far-left extremists generally tend to smell and have poor hygiene. One video, originally posted by Spanish news agency La Bandera, shows the comedic event unfolding.

Jóvenes manifestantes muestran un bote de gel de baño a los acampados de la Puerta del Sol. https://t.co/o9WwEihnDC

The young participants demanded a harder response to immigration than that offered by mainstream political authorities. Some even directed insults at Madrid’s conservative regional president, Isabel Díaz Ayuso, accusing her of insufficiently restrictive policies concerning unaccompanied migrant minors, El País reported.

The event also attracted counterdemonstrators, prompting authorities to shorten the nationalist march’s planned route and position police between opposing groups, according to El País.

More recently, young demonstrators displaying fascist symbols confronted housing activists in Madrid’s Puerta del Sol following Spain’s National Day military parade on Oct. 12, 2026. Some performed fascist salutes and sang the Falangist anthem while police intervened to separate the competing groups, according to the Spanish Eye and Spanish public broadcaster RTVE.

Another video uploaded by Spanish News agency EuroPress shows the rising tensions at Puerta del Sol.

🔴 Tensión en la Puerta del Sol: asistentes al desfile del 12 de octubre increpan y se enfrentan a los acampados por el derecho a la vivienda https://t.co/Qws0x16LFt https://t.co/t0zj3ARD5F

Three people were arrested and one police officer was injured during the October confrontation, according to RTVE. One photo uploaded by Spanish news agency elDiario.es on X shows the people at the event appear to be mostly teenagers and young adults.

‼️Cánticos de Cara al Sol y saludos fascistas entre un grupo de asistentes al desfile del 12 de octubre que ha tratado de entrar a la acampada de Sol https://t.co/vhIvcSnSJ6

Unlike the earlier Falange demonstration, the October confrontation was not primarily organized around immigration. Nevertheless, both incidents illustrate how explicitly fascist symbols remain visible among sections of Spain’s younger nationalist scene.

France has witnessed its own demonstrations involving young nationalist activists, including a massive gathering following the killing of a 23-year-old activist.

Approximately 3,200 people marched through Lyon on February 21, 2026, commemorating Quentin Deranque, who died after being beaten during a confrontation involving opposing political activists, according to Euronews.

A video uploaded by French news agency BFMTV shows the protesters marching in Lyon.

Mort de Quentin Deranque : selon la préfecture, 3.200 personnes participent à la marche à Lyon https://t.co/WdJ9gF1Tgd

The demonstrations attracted participants from multiple organizations within France’s nationalist movement. French president Emmanuel Macron appealed for calm following Deranque’s killing, according to Euronews.

Another video, also uploaded by BFMTV, shows that some protesters carried torches as they marched.

Mort de Quentin Deranque : des torches ont été brandies en hommage au jeune homme à Lyon https://t.co/ZDi7bL6vvD

Images from the gathering showed activists carrying torches and marching through Lyon, a city with a history of confrontations between far-right and far-left militant organizations. The demonstration attracted nationalist supporters alongside known extremists, including neo-Nazi activists, according to Le Monde.

A third video from BFMTV, clipped from its TV channel, shows a wide shot depicting the large number of protesters.

Mort de Quentin Deranque: retour sur cette journée d’hommage à Lyon https://t.co/mYSU3zqExK

Deranque’s death became a political flashpoint, with opponents of France’s far-left France Unbowed movement raising questions about its relationship with militant activists. The killing involved suspects allegedly connected to the radical left, while the party’s leadership denied responsibility and condemned the violence, according to the Associated Press.

France’s militant nationalist movement has also staged demonstrations invoking older neo-fascist traditions.

On May 10, 2025, activists associated with the Comité du 9 Mai marched through Paris carrying Celtic crosses and other symbols during an annual commemoration. Some participants displayed neo-Nazi insignia and were linked to previously dissolved organizations, according to independent footage published by CLPRESS.

As in Milan, the Paris event centered on a historical commemoration rather than immigration. Its significance lies in the continued coordination of openly neo-fascist organizations, rather than evidence that conservative French voters broadly support their ideology.

Elsewhere in Europe, immigration-related street movements have demonstrated a capacity to mobilize substantially larger crowds; although their participants were not ‘far-right’ or fascists, they were conservatives advocating for the conservation of the United Kingdom.

In London, approximately 150,000 people attended the Sept. 13, 2025, Unite the Kingdom rally organized by anti-immigration activist Tommy Robinson, according to a subsequent attendance estimate released by the Metropolitan Police.

One video uploaded by Reuters shows the protesters marching, arms linked together, with dozens of English and British flags.

Tens of thousands of protesters marched through central London, carrying flags of England and Britain, for a demonstration organized by the anti-immigrant activist Tommy Robinson https://t.co/T8GEzx73KE https://t.co/izDVFt1ZPf

Participants carried British and English flags while voicing concerns about immigration, national identity and government policies. The protest also produced clashes with police, although participation in the broader gathering did not indicate affiliation with “far-right” organizations, Reuters reported.

Similar immigration-related demonstrations occurred in the Netherlands, where hundreds of protesters clashed with police in The Hague in September 2025. Rioters set a police vehicle ablaze and vandalized a political party’s office, while the demonstration’s organizer subsequently disavowed the violence, according to Euronews.

Poland also witnessed widespread anti-immigration demonstrations in July 2025, with protests organized by the right-wing Confederation party in more than 80 cities. Demonstrators demanded stricter border controls and opposed government immigration policies, according to Euronews. (RELATED: Manifest Destiny Is Born Again Among Young Conservatives On Social Media)

In Austria, roughly 200 political activists participated in a July 2025 demonstration advocating remigration, including participants from outside the country. Police also dealt with multiple counterdemonstrations, which resulted in 56 temporary arrests, according to Austrian public broadcaster ORF.

Despite the growing demonstrations, first-time asylum applications in the European Union fell 27% to approximately 669,400 in 2025, with declines recorded in 24 member states, according to the European Commission. Nevertheless, immigration remains a major rallying issue for nationalist movements across Europe.

The demonstrations highlight the divide between conservatives seeking tighter immigration controls and extremist nationalist organizations. From young Falangists in Madrid to torch-bearing militants in Milan, the gatherings also raise questions about whether Europe’s nationalist movements are attracting a new generation of supporters.

news.originalContent:
Photo by Finn Gomez/Getty Images

Democratic Rep. Haley Stevens broke with both former rival for Michigan’s open Senate seat Abdul El-Sayed as well as their party Sunday to endorse the Republican nominee, Mike Rogers, just two days before the midterm elections.

Hours after making an appearance with Rogers at a Detroit church Sunday afternoon, the congresswoman shocked observers by calling on her constituents to vote for the Rogers. She stated she “does not belong in Abdul El-Sayed’s campaign or stand with Hasan Piker,” during a video posted to her X account after the event.

I am endorsing Mike Rogers for the United States Senate today. https://t.co/pQgfSBuhOJ

“As you may have seen, our Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate, Abdul El-Sayed, said that I was no longer welcome in his campaign and that I should stay away,” Stevens also said. “And he’s right. That’s why I am endorsing Mike Rogers for the United States Senate today.”

“What our students see, what our children see, and who we are as Michiganders is not hate and that is not what we are getting from our Democratic nominee right now,” Stevens continued in the video. “I’m still a very proud Democrat and very much believe in everything I voted for.”

El-Sayed and Stevens have been caught sniping each other over their differing stances on Israel, firing statements back and forth online in the days leading up to the hotly contested midterm election. Stevens narrowly lost to El-Sayed in the Michigan primaries. Notably, she was reportedly disinvited from a competing church event with him and Democratic South Carolina Rep. James Clyburn. (RELATED: Democratic Coalition Appears To Break Down Days Ahead Of Michigan Senate Seat Election)

Stevens issued a statement Friday asking for El-Sayed to apologize for a campaign ad claiming that Jews are responsible for America’s economic woes. El-Sayed, a staunch critic of Israel, responded by asking Stevens to stay away from all his remaining campaign events.

Stevens’s surprise Sunday endorsement prompted quick reactions and statement from both sides of the aisle, as well as online users claiming to be her constituents.

The chair of Michigan’s Democratic Party, Curtis Hertel Jr., issued a scathing statement saying the party “stands united and fully behind Abdul El-Sayed” and that Stevens’s decision to campaign with Rogers “shows that she’s abandoned everything she claims to care about.”

“We reject the attempts by Stevens and bad-faith actors to divide our party and undermine our momentum, and will not allow these eleventh-hour distractions deter us,” it continues.

In addition, Justin German, whose served as Stevens’s chief of staff for eight years, said he and other members of the congresswoman’s team are “shocked and heartbroken” by her endorsement, and expressed their “wholehearted support of El-Sayed.” German resigned from his position along with other members of Steven’s team.

Senate Minority Leader Chuck Schumer similarly expressed his disapproval, having the prospects of his becoming the majority leader possibly threatened by Stevens’ move.

“This is a despicable betrayal from Rep. Stevens,” he wrote Sunday. “Senate Democrats are united in our support for Abdul El-Sayed, because we know he will fight for the economic interests of working families in Michigan, unlike Mike Rogers, who is a tool of Donald Trump and billionaire donors.”

This is a despicable betrayal from Rep. Stevens. Senate Democrats are united in our support for Abdul El-Sayed, because we know he will fight for the economic interests of working families in Michigan, unlike Mike Rogers, who is a tool of Donald Trump and billionaire donors.

Many Democrats have called Mike Rogers “a rubber stamp for Trump’s dangerous agenda,” including Stevens who posted as much two months earlier. With Stevens’s 180-degree turn, however, members of the Republican Party are now praising her.

“When Congresswoman Haley Stevens, who ran against Abdul El-Sayed and knows him better than anyone, stands with Mike Rogers, Michigan should take notice,” Republican National Committee spokesman Hunter Lovell said in a statement to the Daily Caller News Foundation. “Democrats who feel Abdul has abandoned them have a home with Mike, who is building a winning coalition of Democrats, Independents, and Republicans to save Michigan from El-Sayed’s radical, terrorist-sympathizing agenda. The center of Michigan politics has moved, and Abdul is on the wrong side of it.”

President Donald Trump likewise quickly waded into the Sunday firestorm, posting to Truth Social his approval of Stevens’s “bravery.”

“Wow, this is BIG! Congresswoman Haley Stevens, a Highly Respected Democrat, who narrowly lost in the Primary to Abdul Mohamed El-Sayed, and who has been breathlessly wined and dined by the Dumocrats to help in their Michigan Campaign for the United States Senate against Mike Rogers, has just ENDORSED Mike Rogers for Senate!” he wrote. “Her following is huge, and the level of respect from the People of Michigan, especially our African American and Jewish populations, is virtually unparalleled.”

“Haley said what few people are willing to say,” he continued. “She showed great and almost unprecedented loyalty to the Great People of Michigan with what she did. It’s a thing called bravery, and few people have it like just displayed by Congresswoman Haley Stevens!”

عکس از فین گومز/گتی ایماژ
هیلی استیونز، نماینده دموکرات، تنها دو روز قبل از انتخابات میان‌دوره‌ای، از هر دو رقیب سابق برای کرسی باز مجلس سنای میشیگان و همچنین حزب آنها روز یکشنبه جدا شد تا از نامزد جمهوری‌خواه، مایک راجرز، حمایت کند. ساعاتی پس از حضور با راجرز در یکی از کلیساهای دیترویت، ناظر عضو کنگره در بعدازظهر یکشنبه رای‌دهنده رای‌دهنده او را شوکه کرد. او طی ویدئویی که پس از این رویداد در حساب X او ارسال شد، اظهار داشت که "به کمپین عبدالالسید تعلق ندارد یا در کنار حسن پیکر ایستاده است." من امروز از مایک راجرز برای حضور در مجلس سنای ایالات متحده حمایت می کنم. https://t.co/pQgfSBuhOJ
استیونز همچنین گفت: «همانطور که ممکن است دیده باشید، نامزد دموکرات ما برای مجلس سنای ایالات متحده، عبدالالسید، گفت که دیگر از من در کمپین انتخاباتی استقبال نمی‌کنم و باید دور بمانم.» "و حق با اوست. به همین دلیل است که من امروز از مایک راجرز برای حضور در مجلس سنای ایالات متحده حمایت می کنم.
استیونز در این ویدئو ادامه داد: «آنچه دانش‌آموزان ما می‌بینند، بچه‌های ما می‌بینند، و ما به‌عنوان میشیگاندایی هستیم، نفرت نیست و این چیزی نیست که ما در حال حاضر از نامزد دموکرات‌مان دریافت می‌کنیم.» من هنوز یک دموکرات بسیار مغرور هستم و به هر چیزی که به آن رای دادم بسیار اعتقاد دارم.» السید و استیونز به خاطر مواضع متفاوت خود در قبال اسرائیل در حال تک تیراندازی به یکدیگر دستگیر شده اند و در روزهای منتهی به انتخابات میان دوره ای پر مناقشه، بیانیه هایی را به صورت آنلاین منتشر می کنند. استیونز در انتخابات مقدماتی میشیگان به سختی به السید باخت. قابل توجه، او W

Arsenal record first win at Liverpool in 14 ttempts thanks to Kai Havertz goal

Arsenal went three points clear of Manchester City at the top of the English Premier League after a statement 1-0 win at Liverpool.

The Gunners had not won at Anfield since September 2012, when current coach Mikel Arteta captained the away side to a 2-0 victory, and had gone winless in their past 13 visits.

However, Kai Havertz turned home a low cross from Declan Rice after the home side were caught trying to play out from the back to silence the Kop on 16 minutes. The visitors withstood wave after wave of pressure from Andoni Iraola’s side thereafter.

Liverpool responded strongly with Florian Wirtz curling a free kick against the bar and Alexis Mac Allister heading a good chance over.

Arsenal weathered the storm, though, and defended superbly to keep Liverpool largely at arm’s length after the break, denying the home side a shot on target for the second meeting in succession.

Arteta’s side replaces Manchester City at the top with 24 points from nine games, with City on 21 after losing at home to Brighton and Hove Albion on Saturday.

Liverpool’s second league defeat of the season left them nine points behind Arsenal in fifth place.

آرسنال اولین برد در لیورپول را در 14 تلاش به لطف گل کای هاورتز به ثبت رساند.
آرسنال پس از پیروزی 1-0 مقابل لیورپول، سه امتیاز از منچسترسیتی در صدر لیگ برتر انگلیس فاصله گرفت. توپچی ها از سپتامبر 2012 در آنفیلد پیروز نشده بودند، زمانی که مربی فعلی میکل آرتتا کاپیتان تیم میهمان بود و در 13 دیدار گذشته خود کاپیتانی کرد. با این حال، کای هاورتز پس از اینکه تیم میزبان در تلاش برای بازی کردن از پشت برای ساکت کردن Kop در دقیقه 16 دستگیر شد، یک پاس کوتاه از دکلان رایس را به خانه برگرداند. پس از آن، تیم میهمان در مقابل موجی از فشار از طرف آندونی ایراولا ایستادگی کرد. لیورپول به شدت پاسخ داد و فلوریان ویرتز یک ضربه ایستگاهی را به تیر دروازه زد و الکسیس مک آلیستر یک موقعیت خوب را با ضربه سر وارد کرد. با این حال، آرسنال طوفان را پشت سر گذاشت و به خوبی دفاع کرد تا لیورپول را تا حد زیادی در فاصله زمانی پایانی بازی حفظ کند، و در دومین دیدار متوالی از ضربه زدن به دروازه تیم میزبان محروم شد. تیم آرتتا با 24 امتیاز از 9 بازی، با سیتی با 21 امتیاز پس از باخت در خانه مقابل برایتون اند هوو، جایگزین منچسترسیتی در صدر جدول شد. دومین شکست فصل لیورپول در لیگ، آنها را با 9 امتیاز کمتر از آرسنال در رده پنجم قرار داد.

news.originalContent:
The conflict has become a central issue ahead of Tuesday’s polls.

The war on Iran has emerged as a major campaign issue in the United States midterm elections.

Voters are preparing to cast their ballots on Tuesday, November 3, and for many, the effects of the Iran conflict at home are top of mind.

Fuel prices have skyrocketed, driving up the prices of other goods, too.

Polls suggest many Democrats – and Republicans – say this conflict was not worth the consequences.

So will the election shift the Senate and House of Representatives in Democrats’ favour? And what would that mean for the rest of President Donald Trump’s time in the White House?

Presenter: Mohammed Jamjoom

Hassan Ahmadian – Associate professor at the University of Tehran and deputy director of the Middle East Scientific and Strategic Studies Center

Patrick Mara – Chairman of the Washington, DC Republican Party

James Butler – Democratic Party strategist

news.originalContent:
No arrests made after several security officers were reportedly injured during incidents at Saturday’s protests.

Prosecutors in France have launched an investigation into attempted murder after petrol bombs were thrown at security forces during protests in Paris, as video of an officer in flames provoked outrage.

The probe announced on Sunday came after the Paris police prefecture said  several hundred rioters had attacked security forces with projectiles, including a Molotov cocktail.

On Saturday, clashes erupted in Paris and other cities as hundreds of thousands of people staged a third weekend of protests against soaring living costs and deteriorating public services.

Video and images from the demonstrations showed a homemade incendiary device exploding at the feet of a security officer in protective gear, engulfing his lower body in flames.

Prosecutors said the investigation was opened for “attempted murder of persons vested with public authority”.

“Explosive devices were thrown at around 15 gendarmes as well as police officers,” the prosecutor’s office said, referring to military police officers who are part of the French armed forces.

While riots were less widespread than two weeks ago, when France experienced some of its worst unrest in years, Interior Minister Laurent Nunez said on Saturday that the level of violence perpetrated by some was “extraordinary”.

An assessment of the injured was ongoing, prosecutors said, adding that the reported injuries included second-degree burns.

The gendarme struck said his unit was “under assault”, with glass bottles, paving stones, shards of glass and firebombs thrown at them.

“We were hit by several significant incendiary devices,” he told broadcaster RTL on condition of anonymity.

“The flammable substance was so greasy that I could feel it spreading across my skin,” he said. “I kept wondering when it would stop because I really felt as though I had been coated by the heat itself.”

The officer, who received minor injuries, said the leg and shin protections on his riot uniform melted.

The gendarmerie said 13 members of the officer’s unit were injured, according to RTL.

No suspects “have been arrested at this stage in connection with the incident”, the prosecutor’s office said, adding that investigators were working to identify those responsible.

More than 770 people were arrested across France, the interior ministry said.

A total of 159 members of law enforcement were injured during protests and Halloween celebrations, it added.

The protests come in a tense political climate, with presidential elections six months away and far-right frontrunner Marine Le Pen vowing to restore law and order if elected next year.

Le Pen, the leader of the far-right National Rally party, said on X that those responsible for the firebomb attack must be “punished with the utmost severity”.
news.content: پس از اینکه گزارش شد چندین افسر امنیتی در جریان اعتراضات روز شنبه مجروح شدند، بازداشتی صورت نگرفت. دادستان های فرانسه تحقیقاتی را در مورد تلاش برای قتل پس از پرتاب بمب های بنزینی به سمت نیروهای امنیتی در جریان اعتراضات در پاریس آغاز کردند، زیرا ویدئویی از یک افسر در شعله های آتش خشم را برانگیخت. تحقیقات روز یکشنبه پس از آن اعلام شد که اداره پلیس پاریس گفت: صدها شورش‌گر با پرتابه‌هایی از جمله کوکتل مولوتف به نیروهای امنیتی حمله کردند. روز شنبه، درگیری‌ها در پاریس و سایر شهرها آغاز شد زیرا صدها هزار نفر برای سومین آخر هفته اعتراض خود را علیه افزایش هزینه‌های زندگی و بدتر شدن خدمات عمومی برگزار کردند. ویدئو و تصاویر از تظاهرات نشان می‌دهد که یک دستگاه آتش‌زای دست‌ساز در زیر پای یک افسر امنیتی با وسایل حفاظتی منفجر می‌شود و پایین تنه وی را در آتش می‌سوزاند. دفتر دادستانی با اشاره به افسران پلیس نظامی که بخشی از نیروهای مسلح فرانسه هستند، گفت: "مواد انفجاری به سمت حدود 15 ژاندارم و همچنین افسران پلیس پرتاب شد." دادستان گفت که ارزیابی مجروحان ادامه دارد و افزودند که جراحات گزارش شده شامل

news.originalContent:
Stevens lost the Democratic primary to Abdul El-Sayed, and she is now endorsing his Republican opponent in the Senate race.

In a blow to Democrat Abdul El-Sayed’s campaign for the United States Senate in Michigan, his former primary opponent, US Representative Haley Stevens, has endorsed Republican candidate Mike Rogers.

Stevens stunned party officials on Sunday by appearing with Rogers at a Detroit church service as tensions between her and El-Sayed boiled over two days before the election that will determine the balance of power on Capitol Hill.

“I am endorsing Mike Rogers for the US Senate. Today, I do not belong to Abdul’s campaign,” she said in a video posted on X.

Stevens’ surprising support for US President Donald Trump’s endorsed candidate in the tightly contested race comes after she was uninvited to a joint event on the same day with El-Sayed, who defeated her by a slim margin in the August primary.

“Who we are as Michiganders is not hate, and [that] is not what we are getting out of our Democratic nominee right now,” Stevens said.
news.content: استیونز در انتخابات مقدماتی دموکرات ها به عبدالالسید شکست خورد و اکنون از رقیب جمهوری خواه خود در رقابت های سنا حمایت می کند. در ضربه ای به کمپین دموکرات عبدالالسید برای مجلس سنای ایالات متحده در میشیگان، رقیب اولیه سابق او، نماینده ایالات متحده، هیلی استیونز، از مایک راجرز، نامزد جمهوری خواه حمایت کرده است. استیونز روز یکشنبه با حضور با راجرز در یک مراسم کلیسایی در دیترویت، مقامات حزب را متحیر کرد، زیرا تنش‌ها بین او و السید بیش از دو روز قبل از انتخابات که موازنه قدرت را در کنگره تعیین می‌کند به جوش آمد. او در ویدئویی که در X منتشر شد گفت: "من از مایک راجرز برای مجلس سنای ایالات متحده حمایت می‌کنم. امروز، من به کمپین عبدل تعلق ندارم." حمایت شگفت‌انگیز استیونز از نامزد مورد تایید دونالد ترامپ، رئیس‌جمهور آمریکا در رقابت‌های شدید رقابت‌ها، پس از آن صورت می‌گیرد که او به یک رویداد مشترک در همان روز با السید دعوت نشده بود، کسی که او را در انتخابات مقدماتی ماه اوت با اختلاف اندکی شکست داد.

news.originalContent:
(Photo by Finn Gomez/Getty Images)

Democrat Connecticut Sen. Chris Murphy has been hospitalized after suffering a stroke at his son’s hockey game.

When asked about Murphy’s condition, the Daily Caller received a written statement from his chief of staff, Allison Herwitt, who said the 53-year-old senator began experiencing numbness in his arm Saturday afternoon while attending the game.

Chris Murphy had a stroke and was hospitalized yesterday. He is awake and alert, according to his chief of staff. Full statement from Allison Herwitt: https://t.co/RkFk9h5QnO

“Yesterday afternoon, Senator Murphy started experiencing numbness in his arm while at his son’s hockey game. He was taken to a local hospital, where it was discovered he had experienced a stroke,” Herwitt wrote.

Herwitt added that, “He was transferred to Johns Hopkins for further monitoring and is responding well to treatment. The doctors are encouraged by his progress, he is awake and alert, and we are optimistic he will make a full recovery.” (RELATED: Blue State Senator Admits Who Democrats ‘Care About Most’ In Resurfaced Video)

Murphy is one of several sitting or recent senators who have experienced strokes in recent years. Democrat Maryland Sen. Chris Van Hollen said in 2022 that he had been hospitalized after suffering a minor stroke.

That same year, Democrat New Mexico Sen. Ben Ray Luján was also hospitalized for a stroke, while Democrat Pennsylvania Sen. John Fetterman, then a Senate candidate, suffered a stroke that he later described as near-fatal.

Murphy is the latest lawmaker to experience health issues while serving in office. Former Republican Majority Leader Mitch McConnell was hospitalized earlier this year and remained absent from the Capitol for months. (RELATED: Mitch McConnell Found Unconscious In DC Home Last Month, EMS Dispatch Reveals)

Republican New Jersey Rep. Tom Kean Jr. also had an unexplained absence lasting more than a month before later revealing that he had been dealing with depression.

Then-Republican Illinois Sen. Mark Kirk also suffered a stroke in 2012.

Beyond his role in the Senate, Murphy has emerged as a prominent voice within the Democratic caucus on foreign policy. More recently, he has urged Democrats to take a more aggressive approach to checking President Donald Trump.

Murphy warned during a Middle East Institute event last week that Trump could attempt to restart the Iran war following the election. He also serves as a junior member of Senate Minority Leader Chuck Schumer’s leadership team.

Before being elected to the Senate, Murphy spent six years serving in the House.

هرویت نوشت: "دیروز بعدازظهر، سناتور مورفی هنگام بازی هاکی پسرش شروع به بی حسی در بازوی خود کرد. او به بیمارستان محلی منتقل شد و در آنجا مشخص شد که او دچار سکته مغزی شده است." هرویت افزود که "او برای نظارت بیشتر به جان هاپکینز منتقل شد و به خوبی به درمان پاسخ می دهد. پزشکان از پیشرفت او دلگرم شده اند، او بیدار و هوشیار است و ما خوشبین هستیم که او بهبودی کامل پیدا کند. (مرتبط: سناتور ایالت آبی اعتراف می کند که دموکرات ها در ویدیوی بازنمایی شده بیشتر به چه کسانی اهمیت می دهند)
مورفی یکی از چندین سناتوری است که در سال های اخیر سکته کرده است. کریس ون هولن، سناتور دموکرات مریلند در سال 2022 گفت که پس از سکته مغزی جزئی در بیمارستان بستری شده است. در همان سال، سناتور دموکرات نیومکزیکو، بن ری لوجان نیز به دلیل سکته مغزی در بیمارستان بستری شد، در حالی که سناتور دموکرات پنسیلوانیا، جان فترمن، که در آن زمان نامزد سنا بود، دچار سکته مغزی شد.

Senator Sullivan’s pledge contrasts with the Trump administration’s effort to challenge Alaska’s election certification, if he loses.

US midterms 2026 latest: Who is Alaska’s ‘Decoy Dan’?

Republican Senator Dan S. Sullivan has vowed to accept the election outcome days after the United States Department of Justice (DOJ) filed a lawsuit seeking to decertify the results of the upcoming US Senate race there if the Republican incumbent loses.

“I’m going to accept the election results,” Sullivan, an ally of US President Donald Trump, told CNN on Sunday.

Sullivan’s promise comes just two days before the November 3 midterm election, which will determine control of the US Congress.

He said he was confident of winning, accusing his Democratic opponent Mary Peltola, who is attempting to unseat him, of cheating.

“My opponent and [Senate Minority Leader Chuck] Schumer and his aides are showing complete disrespect for Alaskans, complete disdain in recognising that they couldn’t run on their record, so they had to cheat. And now that that’s been exposed,” he said.

A New York Times report on Wednesday alleged that members of Peltola’s campaign helped recruit a retired teacher named Dan J Sullivan Jr to run for the Senate seat as a spoiler candidate in an attempt to draw votes away from Senator Sullivan.

The report seems to have prompted the Trump administration’s renewed legal push to bar Alaska from certifying its election results, should Senator Sullivan lose.

On Sunday, US District Court Judge Sharon Gleason dismissed the lawsuit, citing it as “infeasible” because many voters had already cast their ballots and the ballots have now been commingled to the point where the identity of each voter cannot be determined.

“More fundamentally, the United States provides no workable plan as to how it proposes to segregate ballots cast for Daniel J. Sullivan on Election Day and then conduct a court-ordered unspecified “investigation” of those ballots in a manner that would preserve voter secrecy,” she wrote.

The Justice Department said on Sunday that it plans to appeal Gleason’s ruling.

The second Sullivan is listed on the ballot as Daniel J Sullivan Jr, while the senator is listed as Dan S Sullivan and marked as a Republican incumbent.

Peltola has insisted she had nothing to do with recruiting the other Sullivan and has called attention to it a “distraction” from the main issues facing Alaskans — namely, high prices caused by US-Israel war on Iran. Her campaign has also denied involvement.

Before a rally on Friday, Peltola was asked whether someone on her campaign could have been involved in recruiting the other Sullivan. “I have no idea,” she told KTUU. “I honestly have no idea.”

Senator Sullivan doubted Peltola’s claims.

“There is no way this went on for a year that they weren’t informing her,” Sullivan told the CNN news programme State of the Union. “She got caught lying, and she’s still lying to the Alaskan people, the media, to all of us.”

Alaska’s Senate race is one of seven key toss-ups that will likely decide whether Republicans keep their majority in the US Congress’s upper chamber.

Both candidates have spent the final days campaigning through Alaska’s vast landscape.

On Saturday night, Senator Sullivan handed out candy at a “trunk-or-treat” event at a recreation centre north of Anchorage, where he quipped his costume was “the real Dan Sullivan”.
news.content: تعهد سناتور سالیوان در تضاد با تلاش دولت ترامپ برای به چالش کشیدن گواهینامه انتخابات آلاسکا در صورت شکست وی است. آخرین دوره میان دوره ای ایالات متحده در سال 2026: "دن فریبنده" آلاسکا کیست؟ سناتور جمهوری خواه دن اس. سالیوان وعده داده است که نتایج انتخابات را چند روز پس از اعلام وزارت دادگستری ایالات متحده برای اعلام نتایج به دست آمده از قانون (DOJ) می پذیرد. اگر رئیس جمهور فعلی جمهوری خواه شکست بخورد، در مجلس سنای ایالات متحده رقابت کنید. سالیوان، یکی از متحدان دونالد ترامپ، رئیس جمهور ایالات متحده، روز یکشنبه به سی ان ان گفت: «من نتایج انتخابات را می پذیرم.» وعده سالیوان تنها دو روز قبل از انتخابات میان دوره ای 3 نوامبر است که کنترل کنگره ایالات متحده را تعیین می کند. او گفت که به پیروزی خود اطمینان دارد و رقیب دموکرات خود مری پلتولا را متهم کرد که تلاش می کند او را برکنار کند. او گفت: "رقیب من و چاک شومر [رهبر اقلیت سنا] شومر و دستیارانش نسبت به آلاسکاها بی احترامی کامل نشان می دهند، در تشخیص اینکه آنها نمی توانند با سابقه خود کار کنند، بی احترامی کامل نشان می دهند، بنابراین مجبور شدند تقلب کنند. و اکنون که این موضوع فاش شده است." گزارش نیویورک تایمز روز چهارشنبه ادعا کرد که اعضای ستاد انتخاباتی پلتولا به استخدام معلم بازنشسته ای به نام دن جی سالیوان جونیور برای نامزدی برای کرسی سنا به عنوان نامزد اسپویلر در تلاش برای دور کردن آرا از سناتور سالیوان کمک کردند. به نظر می رسد این گزارش باعث فشار قانونی مجدد دولت ترامپ شده است، در صورتی که سناتور Sullivan در ایالات متحده روز یکشنبه را از دست دادن نتایج انتخابات خود محروم کند.

news.originalContent:
(Photo by Andrew Harnik/Getty Images)

A federal judge has permanently shut down Republican President Donald Trump’s $10 billion defamation suit against The Wall Street Journal.

U.S. District Judge Darrin Gayles in Miami dismissed the case with prejudice on Saturday, blocking the president from refiling the same claims, according to the ruling. Gayles concluded that Trump failed to show the newspaper acted with actual malice, the standard for public figures in defamation cases.

The judge wrote that the president was “grasping at straws” in his attempt to find fault with the Journal’s reporting, according to the decision. “The Amended Complaint falls short of pleading actual malice,” Gayles wrote. (RELATED: Judge Makes ‘Rarely, If Ever’ Decision Over Trump Admin’s Golf Course Tree-Felling)

A dismissal with prejudice bars Trump from bringing the same complaint again, according to CBS News. A person familiar with the legal strategy told the outlet an appeal is likely.

A federal judge threw out President Donald Trump’s multibillion-dollar lawsuit against The Wall Street Journal and media mogul Rupert Murdoch over a story reporting on his ties to wealthy financier Jeffrey Epstein. https://t.co/lgXv5TnMLO

Trump’s lawyers showed no sign of retreat. “President Trump will continue to press forward in his powerhouse lawsuit against the Wall Street Journal and all of the other defendants,” a spokesperson for the legal team told CBS News.

The fight began with a Journal article published July 17, 2025, according to the Associated Press (AP). The report described a sexually suggestive note that carried Trump’s name inside a 2003 album for Epstein’s 50th birthday. Trump denied any role in it. “This is not me. This is a fake thing,” Trump told the Journal, The New York Times reported.

Trump sued in Miami federal court one day after the story ran, according to the AP. Gayles rejected the first version in April, finding the president came “nowhere close” to proving malice, CBS News reported. His team refiled in May. The amended complaint argued the Journal had been reckless by not explaining how its reporters received and verified the letter, the AP noted.

House lawmakers later subpoenaed Epstein’s estate and secured a redacted copy of the birthday book that held the disputed letter, according to CBS News. Ghislaine Maxwell assembled the album and now sits in prison on a 20-year sentence for aiding Epstein’s sex-trafficking scheme, the AP reported.

The suit also named News Corp, founder Rupert Murdoch, chief executive Robert Thomson, publisher Dow Jones and two Journal reporters, according to the Times.

Trump has filed similar claims against other outlets, with active cases against the BBC and The New York Times, the AP reported.

(عکس از اندرو هارنیک/گتی ایماژ)
یک قاضی فدرال برای همیشه شکایت 10 میلیارد دلاری دونالد ترامپ رئیس جمهور جمهوری خواه برای افترا علیه وال استریت ژورنال را متوقف کرد. بر اساس این حکم، قاضی منطقه دارین گیلز در میامی با تعصب این پرونده را رد کرد و رئیس جمهور را از طرح مجدد همان ادعاها منع کرد. گیلز به این نتیجه رسید که ترامپ نتوانست نشان دهد روزنامه با سوء نیت واقعی عمل می‌کند، معیاری برای شخصیت‌های عمومی در پرونده‌های افترا. قاضی نوشت که رئیس‌جمهور در تلاش برای ایراد گرفتن از گزارش ژورنال، طبق این تصمیم، «از کاه چنگ می‌زد». گیلز نوشت: «شکایت اصلاح شده از سوء نیت واقعی برخوردار نیست. (مرتبط: قاضی در مورد قطع درختان زمین گلف توسط مدیر ترامپ تصمیم «به ندرت، اگر هرگز» می گیرد)
به گزارش سی بی اس نیوز، اخراج با تعصب، ترامپ را از طرح مجدد همان شکایت منع می کند. فردی که با استراتژی حقوقی آشناست به رسانه گفت که احتمال تجدیدنظر وجود دارد. یک قاضی فدرال شکایت چند میلیارد دلاری دونالد ترامپ رئیس جمهور آمریکا علیه وال استریت ژورنال و غول رسانه ای روپرت مرداک را به دلیل گزارشی درباره روابط او با جفری اپستین سرمایه دار ثروتمند رد کرد. https://t.co/lgXv5TnMLO
وکلای ترامپ هیچ نشانه ای از عقب نشینی نشان ندادند. سخنگوی تیم حقوقی به سی‌بی‌اس نیوز گفت: «رئیس‌جمهور ترامپ به پیشبرد دعوای قدرتمند خود علیه وال استریت ژورنال و سایر متهمان ادامه خواهد داد.» مبارزه با انتشار مقاله‌ای در ژورنال آغاز شد.

news.originalContent:
رسانه‌های ایران از درگذشت حمید علیدوستی، بازیکن سابق تیم ملی فوتبال ایران و باشگاه هما خبر داده‌اند.

به گزارش خبرگزاری ایسنا، آقای علیدوستی به دنبال «ابتلا به سرطان پروستات و استخوان در بیمارستان عرفان نیایش تهران به علت ایست قلبی» درگذشت.

آقای علیدوستی متولد ۲۱ اسفند ۱۳۳۴ بود و سابقه بازی در تیم ملی فوتبال ایران و باشگاه‌های هما، دارایی، کشاورز و سایپا را داشت.

او همچنین به عنوان سرمربی در تیم‌های پیکان، سایپا، هما، تراکتور، تیم زیر ۲۰ سال و زیر ۱۷ سال ایران فعالیت داشت.

از زندگی شخصی و ورزشی حمید علیدوستی فیلم مستندی به نام «سمفونی حمید» به کارگردانی و نویسندگی جعفر صادقی ساخته شده است که در سال ۱۴۰۰ در افتتاحیه جشنواره سینما حقیقت به نمایش درآمد و در آن جز چهره‌های سرشناس فوتبال ایران، ترانه علیدوستی دخترش هم حضور داشتند.

او از فوتبالیست‌هایی بود که هنر و موسیقی را جدی تعقیب می‌کرد و گفته نام دخترش را به دلیل عشقش به موسیقی ترانه گذاشته است.

او که دهه شصت از معدود بازیکنانی بود که از باشگاهی جز استقلال و پرسپولیس به تیم ملی رسیده بود. حمید علیدوستی در اواسط دهه شصت خورشیدی راهی فوتبال آلمان شد و در فصل ۱۹۸۷-۱۹۸۶ برای باشگاه زالمرور در بوندس‌لیگای ۲ (دسته دوم آلمان) در ۳۰ بازی ۱۰ گل زد. او یکی از نخستین بازیکنان ایرانی است که حضور در یک لیگ معتبر خارجی را تجربه کرد؛ اتفاقی که در آن سال‌ها بسیار نادر بود.

او سابقه مربیگری در باشگاه‌هایی مثل پیکان و سایپا و هما داشت و در تیم‌های هما، دارایی، کشاورز و سایپا بازی کرده بود.

آخرین فعالیت ورزشی آقای علیدوستی در تیرماه ۱۴۰۴ بود که به‌عنوان مدیر فنی و رئیس آکادمی باشگاه چادرملو اردکان معرفی شد. سال پیش از آن هم در تیم بهمن در لیگ دو مدیر فنی بود.

حمید علیدوستی یکی از شاخص‌ترین و فنی‌ترین مهاجمان فوتبال ایران محسوب می‌شد و در جام ملت‌های آسیا ۱۹۸۰ و ۱۹۸۴ مهاجم ثابت تیم ملی بود و در بازی‌های آسیایی ۱۹۸۲ و ۱۹۸۶ هم به میدان رفته و گل زده بود.

او که با تیم هما سابقه قهرمانی در مسابقات باشگاه‌های تهران را داشت، در سال ۱۳۷۲ به سایپا پیوست و در آخرین سال‌های بازی‌اش دو بار با این تیم قهرمان لیگ فوتبال ایران شد.

حمید علیدوستی یکی از شاخص‌ترین و فنی‌ترین مهاجمان فوتبال ایران محسوب می‌شد و در جام ملت‌های آسیا ۱۹۸۰ و ۱۹۸۴ مهاجم ثابت تیم ملی بود و در بازی‌های آسیایی ۱۹۸۲ و ۱۹۸۶ هم به میدان رفته و گل زده بود.

او که با تیم هما سابقه قهرمانی در مسابقات باشگاه‌های تهران را داشت، در سال ۱۳۷۲ به سایپا پیوست و در آخرین سال‌های بازی‌اش دو بار با این تیم قهرمان لیگ فوتبال ایران شد.

news.originalContent:
Massachusetts could take down a 2024 gun law rammed through the state legislature in the aftermath of a landmark Supreme Court ruling if a campaign by pro-Second Amendment activists succeeds Tuesday.

After the Supreme Court struck down New York’s discretionary system for issuing concealed carry permits in New York State Rifle and Pistol Association v. Bruen in June 2022, Massachusetts began the process of altering its gun laws to comply with the high court’s decision. Like other states who had “may issue” systems for issuing permits similar to New York’s, however, Massachusetts’s lawmakers seized the opportunity to enact additional restrictions on law-abiding gun owners. Furthermore, outside backers of the legislation, such as Moms Demand Action, spoke at rallies and events held by anti-Second Amendment groups, according to Gun Owners Action League (GOAL). (RELATED: ‘AK Guy’ Roasts Dem Over Ad Supporting Blue State’s Gun Ban)

The police are three minutes away. What do you do until they arrive? Protect your right to protect your family. Vote No on 9 on November 3. #NoOn9 #Massachusetts #CivilRights https://t.co/Ewf9nVZ3Xe

Pro-Second Amendment activists, such as the Gun Owners’ Action League (GOAL), previously secured nearly 100,000 signatures to put a referendum on the 2026 Massachusetts ballot to ask if Bay State voters supported H.4885, a gun-control law passed in 2024. Such a move would normally block the law from taking effect until after the referendum, but Democratic Gov. Maura Healey had added an emergency provision Oct. 1 to keep the law in force.

Lawmakers added provisions in the legislation that further restrict modern semiautomatics, imposing registration criteria that targeted certain muzzleloaders, added new license requirements to own any semiautomatic firearm, imposed new stipulations on home-built firearms, and added training prerequisites for those seeking carry permits.

Nonresidents were also made to have to jump through additional hoops, including the requirement to acquire a “temporary” license to carry, as well as having to register all firearms and comply with the state’s serialization requirements. The legislation even made it impossible for an out-of-state resident to take any child hunting in the state.

“GOAL has serious concerns about the exemptions in § 129C being used properly by the state. Nonresidents found in possession of firearms have been treated so harshly in MA since the passage of Ch 135 [sic], that GOAL’s worry is that even if one can prove they’re transporting the proper firearms in the proper manner, it will not insulate them from prosecution,” the pro-Second Amendment group states on its website, responding to a February 2026 legal opinion from a partnering attorney. “While these exemptions should prevent such a situation, the current legal climate created by Ch 135 could still result in many hours and funds being spent on defending oneself in court.”

Neither GOAL nor the Massachusetts Coalition to Prevent Gun Violence responded to requests for comment from the Daily Caller News Foundation.

Most Massachusetts voters appear to support the gun-control measure, with 70% of respondents to a poll released by the MASSInc Polling Group saying they were inclined to vote “yes” on the measure, which would allow it to remain in force. The survey of 800 likely voters was conducted from Sept. 14-22 for the CommonWealth Beacon.

(مرتبط: «AK Guy» به دلیل تبلیغ حمایت از ممنوعیت اسلحه Blue State، دم را برشته می‌کند)
پلیس سه دقیقه فاصله دارد. تا رسیدن آنها چه می کنید؟ از حق خود برای محافظت از خانواده خود محافظت کنید. در 3 نوامبر به شماره 9 رأی منفی دهید. #NoOn9 #Massachusetts #CivilRights https://t. co/Ewf9nVZ3Xe
فعالان طرفدار متمم دوم، مانند اتحادیه اقدام صاحبان سلاح (GOAL)، قبلاً نزدیک به 100000 امضا را برای برگزاری یک همه پرسی در رأی گیری سال 2026 ماساچوست به دست آوردند تا بپرسند آیا رای دهندگان ایالت خلیج از H.4885، یک قانون کنترل اسلحه که در سال 2024 تصویب شد، حمایت می کنند.
